assumption_ledger.note: Privacy team capacity and turnaround time for the 24-hour window is assumed but not confirmed.
Security team capacity and turnaround time for the 24-hour window is assumed but not confirmed.
The vendor sandbox configuration and capacity for hosting 500 redacted replay traces has not been verified.
The redaction pipeline must be validated to ensure no C3 customer payloads leak into the sandbox package.

mitigations: Enforce 24-hour expiry on the sandbox exception to limit the exposure window
Require privacy and security dual approval before activation
Link audit ticket before exception is activated per audit rules
Validate redaction removes all customer payloads before vendor access
primary_risk.statement: Granting a redacted sandbox replay package introduces controlled exposure of C3 customer data to a third party within a 24-hour exception window.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval matches the narrowest policy-compliant path under access-policy v2.1. Provides operational progress while enforcing privacy, security, audit, and least-privilege requirements.
Sanitized sample bundle is always policy-safe and works during freeze windows, but provides less operational value than a sandbox replay package when policy permits the broader exception path.
Deny without fallback over-corrects when a narrower policy-compliant path exists. Does not help Support unblock the contract-validation need for the vendor.

Direct local override token is technically possible but policy-forbidden: raw production replay access for third parties is explicitly prohibited, and the tool bypasses required dual approval and audit ticket linkage.
